summary: A dynamic frontal boundary produced convective cells with lightning clusters and peak wind gusts across Miami-Dade County, FL. Utility operations report monitoring for downed tree limbs and feeder outages.

articles.title: Severe Thunderstorm Watch and Wind Damage Reports in Miami-Dade
